title: Ohm's Law Verification Lab
safety_notes: Power off the breadboard circuit before making or changing any wiring connections.
Do not exceed the resistor's rated power dissipation (1/4 W) -- verify with the calculated I^2*R before applying voltage.
Report any component that becomes hot to the touch to the TA immediately and disconnect power.

steps.instruction: Build the series circuit on the breadboard: power supply positive terminal -> 220 ohm resistor -> multimeter (current mode) -> power supply negative terminal.
steps.expected_outcome: Circuit is fully connected with no open connections; multimeter display shows 0.00 mA before power is applied.

steps.instruction: Set the DC power supply to 5.0V and enable the output.
steps.expected_outcome: Power supply display confirms 5.0V output with current draw under 50 mA.

steps.instruction: Record the multimeter's current reading and compute the measured resistance using V=IR.
steps.expected_outcome: Computed resistance is within 10% of the resistor's rated 220 ohm value.
